entities.name: Dejan Tomašević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dejan Tomašević is a Serbian professional basketball executive, former player and head of the Olympic Committee of Serbia. He also served as a member of the National Assembly between February 2024 and December 2025. He is a member of the ruling populist Serbian Progressive Party (SNS).
